page.layout: One column of Hebrew dictionary entries, each headword in large Hebrew type at the left, with Latin glosses and Hebrew forms in the running text. No marginal notes. Running head centred at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: אֲבְרָה[?] f. Idem, Job.39.16. Aff. אַבְרָתוֹ Alas suas, Deuteronom.32.v.11. Plur. cum Aff. אַבְרוֹתֶיהָ Penna ejus, Psal.68.14.
הָאָבִיר[?] Hiph. Volare: Futurum, יַאֲבִרֶנּוּ[?] Volabit accipiter, Job.39.29.

אֶגֶד[?] f. Fasciculus; metaphoricè, Cuneus, Agmen militum: Constr. אֶגֶד אֵזוֹב Fasciculus hyssopi, Exod.12.22. Aff. וַאֲגָדָתוֹ[?] Et cuneum suum, id est, hominum & animalium turmas, Amos 9.v.6. Plur. אֲגֻדּוֹת Fasces, Sarcinae, Jes.58.6. Quidam deducunt à גָּדַד[?], ut tradit Aben Esra, Gen.7.11. unde & גַּד Turma.
אֱגוֹז[?] m. Nux, juxta Hebræos interpretes communiter, Cant.6.10. Quidam, Tonsio, Putatio, Collucatio, quasi a גָּזַז[?].
אָגָל[?] m. Gutta: Plur. constr. אַגְלֵי טַל Guttas roris, Job.38.28. Ab.Esra vult, א esse formativum: R.Levi explicat per טִיפֵּי.

אַגָּם[?] m. Stagnum, Jesa.35.7. Plural. אֲגַמִּים Stagna, Jesa.42.15. Const. וַאֲגַמֵּי מַיִם Et stagna aquarum, Jesa.14.23. Aff. אֲגַמֵּיהֶם Stagna eorum, Exod.7.v.19. ex quibus Dagesch euphoniæ causâ ejectum est, aut sunt à forma אֲגַמִּים inquit Kimchi. R.Sal.hic scribit: אגם est collectio aquarum non scaturientium neque fluentium, sed stantium in loco uno.
אַגְמוֹן m. Juncus, à Stagnis, in quibus crescit, Jesa.58.5. Cortina, Ahenum majus, •Job.41.11. quomodo & יָם Mare, ad vas amplum refertur, ut est suo loco. Aben Esra, Stagnum, ex æris calore fumans.
אַגָּן f. Crater; Cant.2.7. Plur. בַּאֲגַנּוֹת In crateribus, Exod.24.6. Jesa.22.24.
אַגְפִּים[?] masc. Plur. Alæ; metaphoricè, Agmina, quomodo Latinis Alæ equitum, Alæ le-gionum.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords and forms are printed with vowel points and dagesh; several vowel signs and the exact Hebrew forms at the line ends are small and uncertain, so they are marked [?]. The word "Quidam" and the words "Quidam deducunt" in the third entry are underlined in print; I have rendered them in italics. The bullet before "Job.41.11." is a printed mark. Page number 6 is printed at top right; the running head אג is printed centred at top.
